issues.detail: The Hebrew verb וַיִּפְשְׁטוּ (from פָּשַׁט) means 'to spread out' or 'to deploy' (in a military sense), not 'to take off clothes' (which would be פָּשַׁט with a different nuance, but here contextually it means 'to spread out/array themselves'). The Chinese '脫下衣服' (take off clothes) is a mistranslation; the correct meaning is 'they spread out/deployed in the Valley of Rephaim'.
